chunks.title: Bowe WP. Probiotics in acne and rosacea. Cutis. 2013;92(1):6-7. PMID 23961518

chunks.title: Walker C, Preshaw PM, Novak J, et al. Long-term treatment with sub-antimicrobial dose doxycycline has no antibacterial effect on intestinal flora. J Clin Periodontol. 2005;32(11):1163-9. PMID 16212578
chunks.snippet: 69 人，20 mg bid，9 个月；粪便与阴道菌群：no evidence that sub-antimicrobial doxycycline treatment exerted an effect on the composition or doxycycline resistance level（培养法）。

chunks.title: Walker C, Thomas J, Nangó S, et al. Long-term treatment with subantimicrobial dose doxycycline exerts no antibacterial effect on the subgingival microflora associated with adult periodontitis. J Periodontol. 2000;71(9):1465-71. PMID 11022777
chunks.snippet: 76 人 9 个月；龈下菌群无差异，但 SDD 组螺旋体比例显著低于安慰剂（P<0.05）。

chunks.title: Thomas J, Walker C, Bradshaw M. Long-term use of subantimicrobial dose doxycycline does not lead to changes in antimicrobial susceptibility. J Periodontol. 2000;71(9):1472-83. PMID 11022778
chunks.snippet: 四项试验汇总，仅龈下药敏/MIC，不含菌群组成。

chunks.title: Preshaw PM, Novak MJ, Mellonig J, et al. Modified-release subantimicrobial dose doxycycline enhances scaling and root planing in subjects with periodontal disease. J Periodontol. 2008;79(3):440-52. PMID 18315426
chunks.snippet: 266 人，40 mg 缓释 9 个月；仅定性陈述龈下菌群无显著改变，无数据。

chunks.title: Skidmore R, Kovach R, Walker C, et al. Effects of subantimicrobial-dose doxycycline in the treatment of moderate acne. Arch Dermatol. 2003;139(4):459-64. PMID 12707093
chunks.snippet: 51 人入组，20 mg bid 6 个月；had no detectable antimicrobial effect on the skin flora（培养法）。

chunks.title: Jo JH, Harkins CP, Schwardt NH, et al. Alterations of human skin microbiome and expansion of antimicrobial resistance after systemic antibiotics. Sci Transl Med. 2021;13(625):eabd8077. PMID 34936382
chunks.snippet: both subtherapeutic (Doxy20) and therapeutic (Doxy100) doses of doxycycline altered the skin microbiome；two of the four Doxy20 subjects grew in the presence of doxycycline；宏基因组测序皮肤/口腔/粪便/阴道，56 天给药。

chunks.title: ORACEA (doxycycline) 40 mg capsules. FDA-approved prescribing information, section 12.4 Microbiology (openFDA)
chunks.snippet: In vivo microbiological studies utilizing a similar drug exposure for up to 18 months demonstrated no detectable long term effects on bacterial flora of the oral cavity, skin, intestinal tract and vagina.

chunks.title: Gallo RL, Baldwin H, Harper J, et al. Impact of Low-Dose Oral Minocycline (DFD-29) on Skin, Gastrointestinal, and Vaginal Microflora in Healthy Adults. J Drugs Dermatol. 2025;24(12):1222-1230. PMID 41329149
chunks.snippet: 米诺环素 40 mg 缓释 16 周，60 人随机；皮肤、粪便、阴道物种丰度与安慰剂无显著差异（16S+培养）。
